title: Birational Quartic Descent, Infinite Duplication Towers, Elementary 2-Descent Rank-Zero Proofs, Group-Law Duality, and Constructive Fermat Descent for Pythapotent Hypotenuse-Leg Pairs
abstract: Halbeisen, Hungerbuhler, and Shamsi Zargar (2026, arXiv:2611.34902v1) introduced pythapotent hypotenuse-leg pairs (hl-pairs) of degree h, reducing pythapotency to positive Mordell-Weil rank of the elliptic curve Gamma_{c^h, d^h}: y^2 = x(x + c^(2h))(x - d^(2h)), proving universal pythapotency for h in {1, 3} (Corollaries 8-9), giving a quartic family for h = 2 (Corollary 10), and relying on Magma to assert rank(Gamma_{5^2, 4^2}(Q)) = 0. We establish four self-contained, elementary, machine-checked theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Explicit Birational Isomorphism Psi: Q_1 -> E_12, Degree-4 Morphism Phi = -[2] o Psi, Quartic Unification, & Infinite Duplication Tower (h = 2): we exhibit the genuine birational isomorphism Psi(m, n, q) = (2(q+n^2)/m^2, 4n(q+n^2)/m^3) from Q_1: 3m^4 + n^4 = q^2 onto E_12: Y^2 = X^3 - 12X with rational inverse Psi^(-1)(X, Y) = (m/n = 2X/Y, q/n^2 = 2X^3/Y^2 - 1), show Phi = -[2] o Psi, unify all four Corollary 10 quartics under (m, n) -> (m+n, m-n), and prove that the duplication endomorphism (m', n', q') = (2mnq, |3m^4 - n^4|, 9m^8 + 18m^4n^4 + n^8) preserves (gcd(m,n)=1, opposite parity, 3 nmid n) while strictly growing q' > q and c' > c; (2) 4-Adic/8-Adic Corollary 10 Obstructions & Elementary Magma-Free 2-Descent Rank-Zero Theorem: we prove mod-4 and mod-8 Corollary 10 obstructions and prove via elementary complete 2-descent that rank(Gamma_{C,A}(Q)) = 0 whenever C = p^k (p = 5 mod 8 prime), A = 2^s (s >= 3), and Q = C^2 + A^2 is prime, yielding the first Magma-free proof that (5, 4) is not pythapotent of degree 2 (C=25, A=16, Q=881); (3) Exact Lemma 5-6 Group-Law Identity (R = +[2]P), Crossed Remark-1 Norm Conservation, Symmetry Dichotomy, & Non-2-Divisibility Barrier: we prove R = +[2]P identically in both coordinates, formalize Remark 1's crossed norm law, contrast Corollary 8 symmetry with Corollary 9 hypotenuse ordering 2c^2 - a^2 < 2c^2 - b^2 iff b < a, and prove that universal points of Corollaries 8, 9, and 10 never lie in [2]Gamma_{c^h, d^h}(Q); and (4) Constructive Fermat Infinite Descent, Elementary Lemma 2 (h=1, 2|h), & Torsion-3/4 Boundary: proving both x^4 + y^4 != z^2 and x^4 - y^4 != z^2 constructively in Lean 4 from Euclidean gcd square-factoring, we prove Lemma 2 (h=1, 2|h) and cd != square without Darmon-Merel, exclude rational 4-torsion, and establish the exact 3-division identity psi_3(x) = 4x^2(x+C^2)(x-A^2) - (x^2 + C^2 A^2)^2.
